description: This is a test source file for Vertex AI Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine integration tests, specifically testing ingestion and querying of the RAG system using the Vertex AI platform. It defines a test class that verifies environment setup, configures ingestion options, and performs vector store queries with Vertex AI.

classes.name: TestRAGVertexAI
classes.description: Test class for validating RAG ingestion and querying using Vertex AI RAG Engine. Inherits from BaseRAGTest and contains methods for environment validation, configuring ingest options, and performing vector store queries.

methods.name: check_env_vars(self)
methods.description: Fixture that checks required environment variables before each test run and skips tests if not set or dependencies are missing.

methods.name: RAGIngestOptions get_base_ingest_options(self)
methods.description: Returns configuration options specific to Vertex AI ingestion, including chunking strategy and vector store settings.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] query_vector_store( self, vector_store_id: str, query: str, )
methods.description: Performs a retrieval query on the specified Vertex AI RAG vector store, returning results with context texts and scores, or skipping if dependencies are missing.
